title: A counterfactual past condition

audience.description: Learners who can describe past events and are ready to compare real and imagined outcomes.

objectives: Connect the if-clause to its imagined past condition.
Produce a response that preserves the imagined condition and result.
context: A teammate asks why a report was not sent before the meeting.

segments.text: If I had known, I would have called you.

task.prompt: Reply with a sentence explaining the imagined condition and its result.
task.revision_prompt: Revise your reply so the imagined condition and the past result are both clear.
task.transfer_prompt: Write a new sentence about an earlier warning that would have changed a later action.

dimensions.label: Imagined past condition
dimensions.rationale: The if-clause identifies a past condition that did not happen.
dimensions.missing_guidance: Name the unreal past condition with a had + past-participle clause.

dimensions.label: Imagined past result
dimensions.rationale: The result clause shows what would have happened because of that condition.
dimensions.missing_guidance: Show the imagined past result with would have plus a past participle.
